stemMd: A student dilutes 25 mL of a 0.80 mol/L solution to a final volume of 200 mL. What is the final concentration?
explanationMd: Solute moles remain constant. Multiply 0.80 by 25/200 to obtain 0.10 mol/L. The eightfold volume increase gives an eightfold concentration decrease.

distractorRationale.a: This assumes only a twofold dilution.
distractorRationale.c: Dilution decreases concentration, not increases it.
distractorRationale.d: This does not conserve the original solute amount.
distractorRationale.e: This ignores the eightfold volume increase.
